title: Minimal primes are dense in the spectrum
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A$ be a commutative finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. In the Zariski space $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the set of points corresponding to minimal prime ideals of $A$ is dense: every nonempty open subset of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ contains a minimal prime point.

source.place: Tag 00RG proof, final sentence: the set of Cohen–Macaulay primes contains all minimal primes and is therefore dense; density is the standard minimal-prime argument used there.
